title_o: What Is in a Name? The Development of Cross-Cultural Differences in Referential Intuitions

replications.quote: US participants made significantly more causal-historical choices than Chinese participants (proportion causal historical choice: US: M = 0.71; SD = 0.46; CN: M = 0.53; SD = 0.50; beta = 1.59, SE = 0.37, t = 4.37, p < 0.01). In sum, we replicated Li et al. (2018) with new samples of adults in the US and China.
